trip_pitch:
Chicago is the ultimate big-city destination for your group, perfectly balancing urban exploration, world-class museums, and iconic skyscrapers that define the modern American metropolis. With its walkable neighborhoods, dense downtown core, and vibrant cultural scene, Chicago delivers the architectural grandeur and cosmopolitan energy that appeals to everyone—from museum enthusiasts to urban explorers who crave the pulse of a major metropolitan center. The city's legendary food scene and carefully curated itinerary ensure Ben's culinary and architectural priorities are met, while Chloe enjoys museum-rich days at a comfortable pace, and everyone experiences the scale and sophistication of true urban living.

Your three-day journey captures Chicago's essence through carefully sequenced neighborhoods and landmarks. Day 1 anchors you in the iconic Loop, starting with Millennium Park and the famous Cloud Gate sculpture before ascending Willis Tower and absorbing world-class art at The Art Institute of Chicago—a perfect introduction that respects everyone's arrival schedules with a 10:00 start. Day 2 shifts to Lincoln Park and the Clybourn Corridor, combining the beloved Lincoln Park Zoo with the historic charm of Wrigley Field, The Brickyard's urban energy, and the scenic Southbank Riverwalk for a neighborhood-focused experience. Day 3 concludes at Museum Campus and Grant Park, where the Field Museum and Shedd Aquarium deliver museum excellence, Grant Park's expansive green space provides walking and reflection, and Roosevelt Collection Shops offer a final urban retail exploration—all bookended by consistent dining at The Dearborn and Broadway Cafe.

You'll base yourselves at the Ambassador Gold Coast—The Chicago Hotel Collection hotel for all three nights at just $82 nightly, keeping costs fair and predictable for the group. Expect mild, dry September weather averaging 23.9°C, perfect for extended walking and outdoor exploration without weather disruptions. Daily schedules respect your group's preference for balanced pacing and no exhausting early mornings, with all activities launching at or after 10:00 AM to accommodate varied arrival times. Meals are anchored at trusted venues, ensuring consistent quality and allowing you to focus energy on iconic sights rather than restaurant hunting.

Chicago awaits with its towering skyline, world-famous museums, walkable neighborhoods, and the authentic urban energy your group craves. This itinerary delivers the big-city experience, cultural depth, and logistical ease that transform a group trip into an unforgettable shared adventure. From the reflective expanse of Cloud Gate to the immersive galleries of the Art Institute, from the historic ballpark to the natural wonders of the aquarium, every day offers the iconic landmarks and urban exploration that make Chicago irresistible.
